pos.personaBrief: Fortaleza led the Serie B in possession and passes, and Ceni said Flamengo should be offensive and like possession; he only uses the counter as a reference when he feels inferior.

pro.personaBrief: His teams were 1st in passes but 20th in long balls, and he wanted better build-up from the back; he did not play direct.

est.personaBrief: The 4-2-4 with mobile forwards and defenders alternating roles at Flamengo, with short touches, points to fluid and relational play, though he thinks defensive errors come from the system.

lar.personaBrief: Isla and Bruno Henrique opened wide to give width, and Gabigol and BH moved across the front line; wide forwards were a core part of the 4-2-4, so he favours the flanks.

blo.personaBrief: Flamengo marked the opponent's build-up and pressed high, in the Jorge Jesus style, and he asks forwards to do the defensive work.

mar.personaBrief: No source on zonal or man-marking; the Guardiola influence and his view that errors come from the system suggest zonal marking, with some man-oriented pressing.

pla.personaBrief: He says he does not change his style, but he works according to how the opponent plays, and he fits his shape to the players he has, as in using three centre-backs when he has three good ones.

res.personaBrief: He promised an offensive, possession-based team and always plays for the goal, but he is cautious defensively when under pressure and described as flexible.

sis.personaBrief: A tactical, system-driven coach who says defensive errors are system errors and gives everyone a defined role, including defensive duties.

jog.personaBrief: A possession side with technical players, Diego starting as number 10 at 36, and a focus on short passing rather than duels.

bas.personaBrief: He brought back Muniz from loan and used youngsters, but built Fortaleza and Flamengo from signings and used veterans like Diego, so he is balanced and leans to buying.

lid.personaBrief: He says he does not command everything and is adored for the bonds he created, but he is described as an obsessive, Simeone-like boss; he tends to listen and apply rules equally.
